text_block_list.text:
The day of the debut race had finally 
arrived. The early morning Kyoto 
Racecourse was wrapped in crisp, clear 
air.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... At last, I too have been permitted 
to set foot upon this land.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
O heavens, O earth, O spirits breathing 
upon the turf, please bestow your 
blessings upon the Holy Maiden, Red 
Desire—!

"She was radiating an extraordinary aura. 
It didn't look like there was any need to 
worry."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the time has finally come. Since 
being born into this world, through 
countless years—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The time has finally come to take a giant 
first step into another world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"If I can seize absolute brilliance in 
this race... the door I must pass through 
will surely swing wide open."
choice_data_list:
So you're going to another world today... 
is that what you mean?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If only I could attain perfection's 
brilliance—perhaps then.

Whether the "Other-sekai" she talks about 
really exists or not... To be honest, I 
still don't know for sure.

“Still, there is no doubt that to her, it 
is an unshakable truth and an 
irreplaceable dream.”

"That is precisely why I will place my 
absolute faith in Red Desire."
choice_data_list: Got it. Let's seize that radiance!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! In the name of the Saint, without 
fail!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
W-What should I do? My heart feels like 
it's going to burst...!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if I can run just like I did in 
training... Ah... wait, how was I supposed 
to run again...?!"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...I can hear it. The voice guiding me to 
another world."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I am Red Desire. The chosen Saint who will 
one day reach the otherworld—and guide its 
lost souls.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Today, I shall present to you all the 
moment Saint Red Desire lays her hand upon 
the door to the other world...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"That girl... She shows an incredible 
composure that's unheard of for a Junior 
Class." "She must be remarkably 
intelligent and mature..."
choice_data_list: (...Looks like she didn't hear the line.)
(...Looks like she didn't hear the line.)

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —The time is ripe.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I shall be on my way.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Even if it means saying a permanent 
farewell to this world, I will fulfill my 
mission.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. This grand stage exists only because 
of your dedication— I shall undoubtedly 
seize glory and bring it back to you.

A saint dashing forward, aiming for that 
other world. —I want to know more about 
the true nature of that wish.

"Or... once this race concludes, will she 
have departed for an alternate world?"

Red Desire's foundational trial is now 
raising its curtain—
